steps.name: Minimise
steps.details: Relax overlaps and bad contacts with an energy minimiser before any dynamics; keep the cell fixed at the packed density.

steps.name: Anneal
steps.details: Heat and cool the model in several cycles so chains can escape local packing traps without changing the composition.

steps.name: NVT
steps.details: Hold the volume and equilibrate the temperature with a thermostat until the potential energy plateaus.

steps.name: NPT
steps.details: Couple a barostat and thermostat so the cell relaxes toward the target density at the production temperature and pressure.

steps.name: Production
steps.details: Run the equilibrated model at the target conditions and sample the trajectory for the reported property averages.
